facts.claim: Changi Airport's page: MRT from Changi Airport station to Tanah Merah (change to the East-West line towards Tuas Link) or to Expo (Downtown line towards Bukit Panjang); first train to Tanah Merah 5:31am Monday to Saturday and 5:59am on Sundays and public holidays; last connection to Tuas Link 11:18pm daily; a taxi to the city takes about 30 minutes and costs S$25 to S$45 metered plus an airport surcharge of S$8 (5pm to 11:59pm) or S$6 at other times; payment by contactless Mastercard/Visa, mobile wallets, EZ-Link, NETS FlashPay and the Singapore Tourist Pass, with admin fees on foreign-issued cards; taxis and private hire cars available 24 hours.
